structure: Main prediction: number 42 is being called, but the man with ticket 42 is asleep.
Second prediction: the overflowing water cup and the wet floor.
Third prediction: the block tower and the crawling toddler; the sneezing woman and the mask box.
Ending: the man in the sling reading the two-hour wait sign may leave.
modelAnswer: I think several things are going to happen in this waiting room very soon. First, the screen above the reception desk says 'Now serving 42'. The problem is that the man holding ticket number 42 is fast asleep in his chair, so he's going to miss his turn unless someone wakes him up. Next to the water cooler, a woman is filling a paper cup, but she hasn't noticed that the water is already overflowing onto the floor. Somebody might slip on that puddle. In the play area, a little boy is adding another block to a tall tower, and a toddler is crawling right toward it, so the tower will most likely get knocked over. Also, one woman is sneezing and the man beside her is leaning away, so the receptionist might offer her a mask from the box on the desk. Finally, the man in the doorway with his arm in a sling is reading a sign that says the wait is about two hours, so he might decide to go somewhere else.

usefulExpressions.usageVi: Vấn đề là… — dẫn vào manh mối chính của dự đoán
Trừ khi có ai đánh thức — thêm điều kiện cho dự đoán
Rất có thể sẽ bị xô đổ — bị động + mức độ chắc chắn
Có thể sẽ quyết định… — dự đoán với mức chắc chắn thấp

commonMistakes: Quên giải thích vì sao bạn dự đoán như vậy; luôn nối manh mối với 'so…'.
Nói sai số: 'the man has number forty-two ticket' → 'the man holding ticket number 42'.
Dành quá nhiều thời gian tả phòng chờ; hãy chuyển ngay sang 'what will happen next'.
